papers.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% t
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06851）：Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data 把'base model 不会 reasoning / 必须 RL 训练才会'拉到'在 base model 开头固定特定 starting-token cue 即可让 base model 与 RL-trained counterpart 在 math/coding 上 competitive'——Olmo-3-7B MATH-500 pass@1 从 42% 拉到 78%（cue '.\n\nOkay'）、Qwen3-14B 从 72% 拉到更高（cue 'Alright,'）。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation × context-engineering 的'starting-token cue as RL replacement'即时资产——'cue engineering replaces RL training'范式可迁移到任何'reasoning-style RL is needed'的子方向（math / code / agent planning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × llm-evaluation × memory 主线在'低成本 reasoning enablement'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 cue 形式化（哪些 cue 对哪些 task 有效、cue 是不是可学）、跨 base model 家族（Olmo / Qwen / Llama）验证、跨 RL 范式（RLHF / DPO / GRPO）对照、是否存在 adversarial cue selection。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'starting-token cue reasoning' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language ver
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06829）：CLIFT（ConformaL self-verIFication for web agent Training and Test-Time Scaling）把 open-source web agent 强化学习的'binary task success 太稀疏、frontier-LM judge 太贵且部署时不可用'拉到'conformal self-verification 自校准 verifier'——训练时让 agent 答 natural-language verification question，部署时用 conformal 给出校准过的置信度。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 的'conformal self-verification for web agent'即时资产——'self-verification replaces frontier judge'范式可迁移到任何'sparse reward + expensive judge'子方向（code agent / tool-use agent / multi-step planning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 主线在'calibrated self-supervision for agent RL'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 conformal 形式化（miscoverage guarantee / non-conformity score 设计）、跨 web agent baseline（WebArena / Mind2Web）、test-time scaling 协议、与 frontier-judge baseline 对照。今日动作：即时路线资产，写'clift conformal self-verification' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performa
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06830）：MemPilot 把 agent memory 从'query-agnostic preprocessing / specialized operations'拉到'on-demand multimodal memory curation at inference'——在 agent runtime 才决定哪些 memory 要 curate / 怎么处理、保持对 performance-cost tradeoff 的 flexible control。是 context-engineering × ai-agent × multimodal-agent 的'on-demand multimodal memory'趋势资产——'runtime memory curation'范式可迁移到任何'agent memory governance'子方向（retrieval trigger / write decision / memory compression），与昨日 / 上周 context-engineering × memory 主线在'agent controls its own memory budget'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 on-demand 触发协议、multimodal memory 形式化、跨 agent task 验证、与 query-agnostic memory baseline 对照。

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.abstract: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06843）：Recursive Video In-Context Learning 把 robot agent 的 video memory 从'full video 每 turn 都看 / 固定 keyframe 丢 contact detail'拉到'recursive video ICL with frame-level rollout'——full video 慢、fixed keyframe 丢 contact 信息、agent 需求随 task 从'structure' 变到 'frames around contact'。是 multimodal-agent × ai-agent × context-engineering 的'recursive video memory'趋势资产——'recursive frame-level rollout'范式可迁移到任何'embodied / robot / world-model rollout'子方向（contact-rich manipulation / grasp / assembly），与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × ai-agent × context-engineering 主线在'agent recursively selects its own memory granularity'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 recursive 触发协议、frame-level rollout 形式化、跨 robot task 验证、与 fixed-keyframe baseline 对照。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.abstract: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06833）：Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II 把 looped LM 的'recurrent state 越接近 fixed point 路径越不重要'推到'truncated BP / terminal KV share for decoding with almost no loss / 1.79× faster prefill student / 2× faster RL from saved rollout states'。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'fixed-point recurrent truncation'趋势资产——'recurrent state close to fixed point = truncation is safe'范式可迁移到任何'recurrent / iterative-refinement'子方向（diffusion LM / Mamba / looped reasoning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 主线在'fixed-point as engineering lever'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 fixed-point 收敛保证、truncated BP 形式化、跨 looped LM baseline 对照、RL save-state 协议。

papers.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06844）：Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers 把 MM-DiT 的'动态 contextual tokens 功能不清晰'拉到'用 bottleneck network 把 contextual tokens 映射到 frozen LLaMA 的 input space 做自然语言 interrogation'。是 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的'contextual-token-to-language projection'长尾 interpretability 资产——'project hidden representation into frozen LM input space'范式可迁移到任何'diffusion / transformer interpretability'子方向（cross-attention map / hidden state probing），与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在'diffusion interpretability via LM projection'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 bottleneck architecture、跨 MM-DiT 任务验证、与 linear-probe baseline 对照。

papers.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
papers.abstract: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitoring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06846）：BiasFlow 把 WGA（worst-group accuracy）从'评估用'拉到'hook-based toolkit 监控 frozen backbone 在新 head 下的行为（IBMI / W-IBMI / feature-projection sensitivity）+ 配对 BiasFlow Regularization 监督正则'——指出 IBMI 被 class-attribute correlation confound 不是 causal feature reliance measure。是 llm-evaluation × ai-k8s-platform 的'geometric backbone monitoring + regularizer'长尾诊断资产——'backbone geometry as diagnostic surface'范式可迁移到任何'frozen-backbone + new-head fine-tuning'子方向（PEFT / adapter / LoRA），与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation × ai-k8s-platform 主线在'frozen-backbone governance'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 hook 实现、跨 backbone 验证、与 WGA baseline 对照。

papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06834）：Direct Intermediate Initialization for Tilted Diffusion Samplers 把 Gaussian-tilted intermediate distribution 从'构造完整 noisy-space target'拉到'pull back 到 clean-space posterior with weaker conditioning + Gaussian bridge transport 到 noisy-space target'——MCGDiff 等 SMC sampler 的 effective observation variance 可拉到高比 ~2× diffusion noise variance。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'clean-space pullback + Gaussian bridge'长尾理论资产——'analytic transport between distributions'范式可迁移到任何'diffusion posterior sampling / bridge sampling'子方向，与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 主线在'diffusion transport theory'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 Gaussian bridge 形式化、跨 tilted sampler baseline 对照。

papers.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
papers.abstract: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06852）：One Figure, Every Canvas 把 ML pipeline figure 跨格式复用（paper column / 16:9 / portrait poster / 1:1 / 9:16）从'silent connection break'拉到'aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout agent pipeline'——给定 raster flowchart + target ratio，输出 structurally faithful / hallucination-free / editable layout。是 multimodal-agent × ai-agent 的'aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart agent'长尾工程资产——'format-agnostic layout agent'范式可迁移到任何'diagram / poster / UI'子方向（slide generation / doc layout），与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × ai-agent 主线在'layout as agent task'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 relayout 形式化、跨 aspect ratio 验证、与 fixed-layout baseline 对照。

papers.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
papers.abstract: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06831）：UniSlider 把 image-editing slider 从'rescaling strength parameter'拉到'perceptually uniform remapping'——slider 移动对应 perceptual change 而非线性插值，避免 partial revert / no visible difference / abrupt transform。是 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的'perceptually uniform slider remapping'长尾 UX 资产——'strength-to-perception remap as engineering lever'范式可迁移到任何'slider / hyperparameter UX'子方向（image editing / 3D generation / audio），与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在'UX as research artifact'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 remapping 形式化、跨生成模型 baseline 对照。
